purpose: Descriptive extension of the already inspected France–Korea Republic match; not fresh validation
start: Every period-1/2 corner Pass event in the lesson-35 denominator
stop: First possession-ID change, period change, new restart pass, shot goal, own-goal event or elapsed time over 15 seconds
shots: Only the same team's non-penalty shots already included in the lesson-29 ledger, after the delivery index
time: Within-period timestamp with subsecond precision; exactly 15 seconds included
assignment: Stop at the next restart so a shot can belong to at most one corner; duplicate assignments are errors
comparison: Compare corners with a phase shot against the recorded direct shot-link rate using the same delivery denominator
limitations: Provider possession and these chosen boundaries are a proxy for a corner phase, not a universal tactical definition. No retrospective window tuning.
